description: The system shall allow [REDACTED] students to create personal accounts using their official [REDACTED] email, their full name, a username, and a password.
The system shall require users to verify their valid email address through a verification sent to their inputted email address.
The system shall allow users to view their profile details, including full name, username, and account email.
The system shall allow users to view what game rosters they have joined on their profile page.
The system shall allow users to view their Discord username on their profile page if they have connected their application account to their Discord account.
The system shall allow users to view profiles for other users, including first name, username, joined game rosters, and Discord name if applicable.
The system shall allow users to view a dashboard interface on the landing page after logging in.
The system shall allow Game Managers and Admins to create events by giving them a name.
The system shall allow created events to be given a date, including day, start time, and end time.
The system shall allow created events to be given a location it is taking place.
The system shall allow Game Managers and Admins to delete created events.
The system shall allow Game Managers and Admins to create schedules for a game.
The system shall allow game schedules to be edited by Game Managers or Admins.
The system shall allow all users to view game schedules.
The system shall allow all users to view all upcoming event details.
The system shall allow Community Members to join rosters.
The system shall allow Community Members to leave rosters.
The system shall allow Game Managers to create shell teams and give them a name.
The system shall allow Game Managers to modify teams.
The system shall allow Game Managers to delete shell teams.
The system shall allow Game Managers to upload VODs.
The system shall allow Game Managers to upload team data.
The system shall allow Game Managers to analyze uploaded team data by leaving comments for Players.
The system shall allow admins to grant Game Manager roles.
The system shall allow Admins to revoke Game Manager roles.
The system shall allow Admin users to grant Admin roles.
The system shall allow Admins to suspend user accounts.
The system shall allow Admins to remove user accounts.
The system shall provide a calendar view for game schedules to Community Members and Players within the game's roster.
The system shall integrate schedules with external calendar services.
The system shall integrate with Discord by allowing user's Discord usernames to appear in the application.
The system shall calculate certain team statistics depending on the game based on data inputted by Game Managers or Admins.
The system shall allow Game Managers to view a team management page for their game.
The system shall allow Players to view VODs uploaded by Game Managers.
The system shall allow Players to view team statistics uploaded by Game Managers.
The system shall support at least 200 concurrent users.
The system shall enforce role-based access control.
The system shall provide a complete interface for desktop users.
The system shall allow users to complete onboarding within 5 minutes.
The system shall display the calendar interface and all associated events within three seconds of arriving on the landing page for logged out users.
